title: RPChess Reboot
runtime: Offline HTML5 / ES modules + local run persistence + local Stockfish 18 WASM worker
visual_theme: Approved RPChess frameless fantasy UI with explicit illustrated Event backdrops, race-specific armies, personalized character art and classical chess role glyphs
gameplay_state: Corrected Events v1 candidate after the second live visual retest. Event artwork no longer relies on a CSS custom-property background: runtime now renders a dedicated full-screen image element with an explicitly page-resolved asset URL and a desktop reading panel capped to 68vw/980px so a large artwork rail stays exposed. The Events stylesheet cache-buster is owned by events-app itself and the events visual regression is part of the canonical npm test gate. Combat art continuity still preserves castling rook identity and now also transforms every non-named temporary pawn asset to the selected queen/rook/bishop/knight role asset on promotion, preserving that promoted art on later moves. Scene transitions and opponent castling art were human-confirmed in the previous retest; Events remain final human-acceptance pending for visible backgrounds and temporary-pawn promotion art.
automation_gate: GitHub Actions is manual diagnostic only; required gate is npm run gate:full
active_docs: docs/00_PRODUCT_VISION.md through docs/18_STARVATION.md; Events final visual retest pending
